summary: 50-ft pole L-4 tower on the St. Joe National Forest in Latah County, built 1935 and gone in 1965; sources disagree on whether it was destroyed or removed.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 50-ft pole tower
facts.status_note: Gone since 1965. Sources differ on whether it was destroyed or removed; none describes the site today.

events.note: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed; Rex's page says removed in the fall after fire season

evidence.quote: This 50' pole L-4 tower, built in 1935, was destroyed in 1965.
East Gold Hill Fire Lookout Tower
Photos courtesy the Fire Lookout Museum and Michael DeMarco

evidence.supports: 1965 tower removed in the fall after fire season
evidence.quote: 1965: The tower was removed in the fall after fire season.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the tower was destroyed in 1965. Rex's page says it was removed in the fall after fire season. All three agree on 1965; the story reports both accounts.

sources.title: East Gold Hill Fire Lookout Tower
East Gold Hill - Forest Lookouts (Rex's Fire Lookout Page)

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out on height (50 ft = 15.2 m) and the 1965 end date; only the manner of the end is disputed (destroyed vs removed). No staffing, access or visit data in any source. A different lookout, Gold Hill (1938 pole tower, abandoned 1948, Boulder Creek Ridge), appears in search results and must not be merged with this record. No new photos added.
